critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 7341 lines — file continues to grow unchecked. Splitting into feature modules (sections/promo, restaurants, shops, orders, odoo) is overdue.

SellerSection.sort_order is `int = 0` (not Optional). If a client sends `sort_order: null` the request fails Pydantic 422 before the sanitiser can coerce it. Docstring/spec says 'sort_order coerced to int' — the coercion only fires for str/float/missing values. Consider `sort_order: Optional[int] = 0` to match the stated sanitisation contract.

Max-6 sections check runs AFTER dedupe/blank-name drop, so a payload with 8 sections containing 2 dupes will silently succeed with 6 sections instead of 400. Not covered by spec explicitly; behaviour is arguably correct (sanitise first) but worth documenting.

effective_price_usd/promo_is_live compare ISO strings lexicographically for date-window check. Works for well-formed UTC-Z ISO timestamps but will misbehave if a promo is stored with a naive/local ISO or with a different offset (e.g. '+03:00'). Consider parsing to datetime before compare.

Promo.value has no server-side upper bound. `percent` allows value=200 → negative price clamped to 0.0, but a UI without validation could accidentally give away product. Consider clamping percent to [0,100] and amount>=0 in the Promo validator.

create_product / update_product spread body.model_dump() into $set — includes promo/product_section_id automatically (good). But there is no validation that product_section_id exists in Shop.product_sections; a stale/typoed section_id silently persists. Same for menu_section_id on menu items. Recommend validating referenced section exists on the parent shop/restaurant (or falling back to null).
